title: Introduction to Ceramics
source_quote: Introduction to Ceramics — This class will introduce you to the joy of creating beautiful, sound, and well-crafted art with clay.
evidence_sentence: Clay classes finish student work in a high-fire gas reduction kiln.
evidence_quote: your work will be finished in a high-fire gas reduction or raku kiln
summary: Learn pinch, coil, and slab construction, glazing, and wheel access (intermediate/advanced only). Tuition covers glaze and kiln firing.
how_to_join: Register via the classes page or Amilia
